releaseTitle: MusicDeck v3.0.1 - Studio Envelope Limiter & DSP Polish
releaseNotes: Acoustic Hotfix: Upgraded the C++ peak limiter to a true studio envelope follower (80ms smooth release decay) to eliminate buzzing harmonics and waveshaping distortion on bass hits. Upgraded filter states to 64-bit double precision, modernized the 3D Spatial Audio vector icon, and decoupled platform audiofx.
